ChatCompletionRequest.title: ChatCompletionRequest
ChatCompletionRequest.description:
Chat completions payload.

Generation parameters (model, temperature, max_tokens, top_p, etc.) are
server-controlled via environment variables and must not be supplied by
callers. Extra fields (tools, tool_choice, chat_template_kwargs, etc.) are
forwarded to the upstream unchanged.

CompletionRequest.title: CompletionRequest
CompletionRequest.description:
Legacy text-completions payload.

Generation parameters are server-controlled. If `messages` is present the
conversation is answered by the chat upstream, so the model's chat
template is applied, and the reply is re-shaped into this endpoint's
envelope.

EmbedRequest.title: EmbedRequest
EmbedRequest.description:
Permissive request model for /embed.

``truncate`` is accepted for backward compatibility with existing clients
but is not forwarded upstream.

RerankProxyRequest.title: RerankProxyRequest
RerankProxyRequest.description:
Rerank payload for /rerank.

Accepts `query` and `texts` (or the `documents` alias). Unknown fields
are allowed so callers can pass provider extras such as `model` and
`top_n`.

TranscribeOutput.title: TranscribeOutput
TranscribeOutput.description:
The only supported output.

Storing the transcript is the caller's job, so there is no `url` mode
here any more; the field remains so existing callers that send
``output_type=text`` keep validating.
